## Before we start

- Open the project and the Chapter 5 page, `05_miad.qmd`.
- Run the setup chunk at the top. It loads the packages and the data.
- Take a pink sticky note as they come around.

**During the hands-on portion**

- A pink note on your laptop lid means you are stuck. One of us comes to you.

## How we run through the code

- We will run Chapter 5 (MIAD) together, one chunk at a time. 
- I will stop for questions at the end of every stage.
- Chapter 6 (CAD) is partly a tour. I will show Stages 1 and 2 on the projector, you will run Stages 3 and 4 with me, and I will show Stages 5 and 6. 
- Chapter 7 (MCAD) if time allows.

# Close

## What we did not get to

- Chapter 7, the multisite cluster design, which combines the two. It is on the site as a reference.
- The "Try it" block at the end of the Chapter 5 page. It has three variations on the matching call.
- The decision flowcharts, for choosing the options for your own study.
- The "Your own data" template. It lists the five objects to replace.

The site and the repository stay up.
